newsitem.title: USA: Synovus sets 3-for-2 split, raises qtly div.
newsitem.headline: Synovus sets 3-for-2 split, raises qtly div.

text.p: Synovus Financial Corp said Monday it has declared a three-for-two stock split and a 22.7 percent increase in the quarterly dividend of its common stock.
On a pre-split basis, the quarterly dividend will be increased to $0.135 from $0.11. The cash dividend will be payable on April 1, to shareholders of record March 21.
The stock split will be issued April 8, to shareholders of record March 21. On a post-split basis, the new quarterly dividend will be $.09 per share.
Synovus is an $8.6 billion asset, multi-financial services company which includes 34 banks serving communities throughout Georgia, Alabama, Florida and South Carolina.
